title: Registration route returns an unhandled 500 if the auth service is miswired
reasoning: The middleware validates that app.state.install_auth_service is an InstallAuthService before using it, but the registration route only checks for None. If the app state contains the wrong object, register_install will raise AttributeError instead of returning the same controlled 503 error used by authenticated requests. This makes startup/configuration mistakes leak as generic internal errors on a public endpoint.
recommendation: Mirror the middleware guard in register_install by checking isinstance(install_auth_service, InstallAuthService) before calling register_install, and return the existing 503 detail when the service is missing or invalid.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and the mismatch is visible only by comparing the router guard with the middleware guard.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a router test where app.state.install_auth_service is an arbitrary object and assert POST /api/install/register returns 503 rather than a 500.
